retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a bold yellow header with massive black typography above a high-contrast, grainy monochrome group portrait.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white band photo
yellow header with bold black text

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-tier vertical composition where the top third is a solid yellow block containing ultra-bold, condensed black lettering, and the bottom two-thirds is a high-contrast, grainy black-and-white photograph of figures in profile and three-quarter views.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold yellow header vs. monochrome photographic base
Massive display type vs. small metadata text
High-contrast lighting on subjects vs. flat background color
Horizontal division between graphic and photographic zones
coreInvariants: Solid yellow header block occupying the top 30-35% of the frame
High-contrast, grainy black and white photographic treatment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are arranged in a horizontal line across the bottom two-thirds, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive black display text in the yellow header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large header, moves down to the high-contrast faces, and finally to the small names at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with type and figures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow paired with extreme value contrast in the monochrome image.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in extreme scale contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed proportions of the display text.
Provides the necessary vintage sans-serif feel with high density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a two-part vertical layout. The top 30% is a solid vibrant yellow block. The bottom 70% is a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of four men in 1970s attire (hats, vests, long hair) standing in a row. The photo should have deep blacks and blown-out white highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, black, ultra-bold condensed sans-serif title in the top yellow block, centered. Add small, black, bold condensed sans-serif names along the very bottom edge on a thin yellow strip.

verificationChecks: Is the main text massive and condensed?
Are the names at the bottom legible but small?

mustRedesign: Any specific logos or catalog numbers

mustAchieve: Harsh black and white contrast in the photo
Tight letter spacing in the header

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow header is not muddy.
Ensure the black and white photo has no gray mid-tones.
Verify the text is perfectly centered in the yellow block.
Confirm the bottom names are aligned to the bottom edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow header block + Bold Condensed Sans-Serif + High-Contrast Grainy Monochrome Photo = 70s Rock Aesthetic
